title: Portable IQA/EQA evidence playback
details: Every evidence ZIP with video now includes 00_OPEN_EVIDENCE.html, an offline browser player designed for external IQA/EQA review
The player has its own draggable timeline, -10/+10 second controls and a timestamp box so reviewers can type a PDF time such as 04:18 and jump straight to it
The player also includes a manual video file picker as a fallback if a computer blocks relative local-file playback
Reviewers are told to extract the ZIP before playback because opening media directly inside an archive can make some operating-system ZIP viewers expose it as a one-way stream
The existing 2.39 protections remain: MP4 fast-start repair at export and STORE mode for video/audio entries with no video re-encoding
